design: Enumerate the original 48 signed four-segment command targets; apply continuous first-order response at every RK4 stage. Reject a design if any roster trajectory leaves common limits. Use 200 post-initial positions. Consider each distinct pair of admissible designs; deterministic lexicographic pair order breaks ties.
criterion: Two laws are compatible on a design when RMS <=3 sigma. Keep pairwise ambiguity, never transitive closure. Minimize the largest forecast distance over all admissible design commands among pairs still compatible on both acquisitions; report also actionable residual pairs and smallest number of acquisitions achieving the predeclared <=3 sigma planning diameter (0,1,2,or >2). Mean across all distinct two-design choices is the uniform-random comparator; full-roster maximin compares the smallest over law pairs of their maximum acquisition RMS. No fitted truth labels used.
stress: After selecting acquisitions from the planning bank alone, compute remaining diameter against twelve smooth challenge target histories: sin(2*pi*cycles*t/8 + phase), cycles {0.5,1,2}, phase {0,pi/2,pi,3pi/2}, same response. Screen domain; report excluded counts. World-level calibration and scientific evaluation remain unopened. Results conditional on finite roster, selected histories and per-record deterministic radius, not statistical error probability.
refinement: Recompute entire course on both independent step sizes; report worst trace error, action or decision changes, and values within the numerical margin of 3 sigma. No changes after observing the challenge.
